style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field, one flat saturated cyan-blue accent field #0FA3DD, and a single broad cream ribbon #F4F0EA as the only background device; no scenery, no gradient mesh
style.iconSystem: hairline callout rules and single-weight thin-line marks only, one accent color, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, large soft front-left key with fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, no hard speculars, skimming sweep only on texture macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-apothecary skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, one saturated cyan-blue accent field #0FA3DD, cream-ivory texture #F4F0EA and charcoal type #1E2226; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a large soft front-left key and fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, no hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter-spacing and generous margins; hairline callout rules and thin single-weight line icons only; product presented upright on its own cap at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with unchanging scale; flat color fields and one broad cream ribbon as the only background devices; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no decorative props beyond the cream ribbon.
noDrift: no extra props beyond the cream ribbon
style.presentationRules: product always upright on its own cap, identical slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle and scale across the set, never tilted, never floating without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC for the one vanity scene, pale card stock #E9EEF2 for the information spread
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, wide letter-spacing, two-line claim blocks in charcoal #1E2226 with one word repeated in the accent blue, generous margins
